conventions.layers: switchable runtime subtrees under PlayableWorld/StreetDetail; ground rows feed the always-on chunk surfaces
conventions.position_m: [x, y, z]; y is the generated land elevation under x, z (terrain_support names the triangle)
conventions.status: placed rows are built when their layer is on; excluded rows keep their source id and the reason
conventions.surface: the visible ground surface at x, z (generated feature kind and material, including the raised street ground); set an item on it at y + bias_m
conventions.yaw_radians: rotation about +Y turning the asset's local -Z front; null when the source gives no direction
